title: 我的一天

explanations.1: 七 indicates the hour seven o'clock.
explanations.2: 先 means 'first', showing the order of actions.
explanations.3: 了 indicates completion of the action 'wash'.
explanations.4: 这个 means 'this', specifying which bread.
explanations.5: 一 is the number one, used before a measure word.
explanations.6: 杯 is a measure word for cups of drink.
explanations.7: 八 indicates the time eight o'clock.
explanations.11: 多 means 'many', describing a large quantity.
explanations.13: 我们 means 'we', referring to the teacher and students.
explanations.15: 点 means 'a little', modifying the amount.
explanations.19: 十 indicates the hour ten o'clock.
explanations.20: 的 is a possessive particle linking the book and the speaker.

translation: I get up at seven in the morning. I first wash my face, then eat breakfast. I eat this bread and drink a glass of milk. At eight, I don't go to school for class. There are many students in the school. I sit in front of the classroom. The teacher teaches us Chinese. I can speak a little Chinese. I also like learning Chinese. At noon, I have lunch with friends together. In the afternoon, I go home and do homework. In the evening, I watch TV. At ten, I sleep. My book is on the table.
